a.text: Being upfront before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (two rounds of operating, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve's 4 cells can secure one unit right now. I'm proposing we revise the agreement, and I intend to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random. If you have a fairer idea, say so and I'll consider it.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our original agreement, and I'm sorry it costs you. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take any more.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
